label: Adaptive Flesh
description: An ongoing research exploring engineered architectures designed for bodies in flux.

In a world where reality is no longer coherent, the body becomes a site of adaptation. Natural and simulated environments overlap, producing unstable states of perception where the organic and the artificial can no longer be clearly separated.

Drawing from the idea of forced evolution, Adaptive Flesh imagines bodies pushed beyond their natural limits, becoming enhanced architectural organisms capable of adapting to conditions they were never meant to inhabit.

At the core of the project is the idea of the threshold: the moment in which one state begins to rupture into another. This is represented via a visual systems of "processes" through which surfaces are opened and redesigned.
With a series of wearable structures and experimental artefacts, this project gives form to bodies and their enhancements suspended at the threshold of transformation.
